# SeroTrackR

[SeroTrackR](https://github.com/dionnecargy/SeroTrackR) is a tool to for
serology data analysis and visualisation, and for the application of the
machine learning algorithms implemented in the `{PvSeroApp}`. The R
package is intended to give users more flexibility in assessing serology
data and manipulate data visualisations to the user’s interest. You can
download the R package using the following:

``` r
# Run once to configure your package to use and deploy SeroTrackR
if(!require(devtools)){
  install.packages("devtools") # If not already installed
} 
devtools::install_github("dionnecargy/SeroTrackR")
library(SeroTrackR)
```

Alternatively you can download the package from the
[remotes](https://remotes.r-lib.org) R package:

``` r
if(!require(remotes)){
  install.packages("remotes") # If not already installed
} 
library(remotes)
remotes::install_github("dionnecargy/SeroTrackR")
```

# Package index

## Global Functions

### Pipelines

Functions that contain entire processing pipelines.

- [`runLDHPipeline()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/runLDHPipeline.md)
  : Run LDH Pipeline from Start to End
- [`runPlasmoPipeline()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/runPlasmoPipeline.md)
  : Run Pk/Pf/Pv Data Analysis Pipeline from Start to End
- [`runPvSeroPipeline()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/runPvSeroPipeline.md)
  : Run PvSero Pipeline from Start to End

## Data Processing

### Plate Handling

Process raw Luminex data and plate layouts.

- [`readSeroData()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/readSeroData.md)
  : Read Raw Serological Data
- [`readPlateLayout()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/readPlateLayout.md)
  : Read Plate Layout/s
- [`getPlateLayout()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getPlateLayout.md)
  : Find and create a master plate layout file

### Quality Control

Quality control checking functions.

- [`getAntigenCounts()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getAntigenCounts.md)
  : Get Count Data for each Antigen from the Raw Median Fluorescent
  Intensity
- [`getCounts()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getCounts.md)
  : Get Count Data from Raw Median Fluorescent Intensity
- [`getCountsQC()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getCountsQC.md)
  : Get All Counts Data
- [`plotBeadCounts()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotBeadCounts.md)
  : Plot Bead Counts per Plate per Antigen
- [`plotCounts()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotCounts.md)
  : Plot Bead Count Data
- [`processCounts()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/processCounts.md)
  : Process Counts from Raw Serological Data file
- [`getRepeats()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getRepeats.md)
  : Check Beads to Repeat
- [`getSampleID()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getSampleID.md)
  : Get SampleID from Plate Layout
- [`plotBlanks()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotBlanks.md)
  : Plot Raw Median Fluorescent Intensity Blanks Data
- [`plotMFI()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotMFI.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) Box Plots
- [`plotModel()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotModel.md)
  : Plot the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody
  Units (RAU) Results Data
- [`plotModel_ETH()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotModel_ETH.md)
  : Plot the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody
  Units (RAU) Results Data based on ETH standard
- [`plotRAU()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotRAU.md)
  : Relative Antibody Unit (RAU) Box Plots
- [`plotStds()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotStds.md)
  : Plot Raw Median Fluorescent Intensity of Standard Curve Data
- [`plotStds_PkPfPv()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotStds_PkPfPv.md)
  : Plot Raw Median Fluorescent Intensity of Pk/Pf/Pv Standard Curve
  Data
- [`plotStds_all()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotStds_all.md)
  : Plot Raw Median Fluorescent Intensity of Standard Curve Data
- [`processPkPfPv()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/processPkPfPv.md)
  : Processing Serological Data for Pk/Pf/Pv MFI to RAU conversion
- [`renderQCReport()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/renderQCReport.md)
  : Generate QC PDF Report

### MFI to RAU Conversion

Functions for converting MFI to RAU.

- [`MFItoRAU()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/MFItoRAU.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody Units (RAU)
  conversion
- [`MFItoRAU_ETH()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/MFItoRAU_ETH.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody Units (RAU)
  conversion based on ETH standard
- [`MFItoRAU_LDH()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/MFItoRAU_LDH.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody Units (RAU)
  conversion for LDH
- [`MFItoRAU_PfPv()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/MFItoRAU_PfPv.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody Units (RAU)
  conversion for either PNG or ETH standard
- [`MFItoRAU_Pk()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/MFItoRAU_Pk.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody Units (RAU)
  conversion for Pk proteins
- [`MFItoRAU_Plasmo()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/MFItoRAU_Plasmo.md)
  : Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) to Relative Antibody Units (RAU)
  conversion for Pk/Pf/Pv Master Function

## Machine Learning Algorithm

### Classification

Classify serological data.

- [`classifyPv()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/classifyPv.md)
  : Random Forest Classification for Pv only in Pk/Pf/Pv analysis
- [`classifyResults()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/classifyResults.md)
  : Random Forest Classification
- [`plotBoxPlotClassification()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/plotBoxPlotClassification.md)
  : Plot Classification
- [`renderClassificationTable()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/renderClassificationTable.md)
  : All Classification Data

## Internals

### Internal helpers

Internal functions and helpers.

- [`checkPlatform()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/checkPlatform.md)
  : Check Platform
- [`convert_dilution_to_mfi()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/convert_dilution_to_mfi.md)
  : Convert known dilution to mfi from fitted standard curve
- [`convert_mfi_to_dilution()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/convert_mfi_to_dilution.md)
  : Convert mfi to dilution using known standard curve fit.
- [`convert_mfi_to_dilution_no_bounds()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/convert_mfi_to_dilution_no_bounds.md)
  : Convert mfi to dilution using known standard curve fit and no bounds
- [`convert_mfi_to_dilution_no_lower_bound()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/convert_mfi_to_dilution_no_lower_bound.md)
  : Convert mfi to dilution using known standard curve fit and no lower
  bound
- [`fit_standard_curve()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/fit_standard_curve.md)
  : Fit a standard curve to known mfi and dilution values.
- [`getGithubRelease()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/getGithubRelease.md)
  : Get GitHub Version
- [`makeCard()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/makeCard.md)
  : Make Card in Fluent UI
- [`relabel_columns()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/relabel_columns.md)
  : Relabel column names to Standardised Naming Convention
- [`renderReport()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/renderReport.md)
  : Render Markdown report
- [`renderTwoCols()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/renderTwoCols.md)
  : Create two columns in Fluent UI
- [`renderDetailsList()`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/renderDetailsList.md)
  : Create a Fluent UI Table
- [`example_BioPlex_PvLDH_plate1_xlsx`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/example_BioPlex_PvLDH_plate1_xlsx.md)
  : Example Serological Dataset: Bioplex PvLDH Plate 1
- [`example_BioPlex_plate1_xlsx`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/example_BioPlex_plate1_xlsx.md)
  : Example Serological Dataset: Bioplex Plate 1
- [`example_BioPlex_plate2_xlsx`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/example_BioPlex_plate2_xlsx.md)
  : Example Serological Dataset: Bioplex Plate 2
- [`example_BioPlex_plate3_xlsx`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/example_BioPlex_plate3_xlsx.md)
  : Example Serological Dataset: Bioplex Plate 3
- [`example_MAGPIX_pk_10std_plate1_csv`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/example_MAGPIX_pk_10std_plate1_csv.md)
  : Example Serological Dataset: MAGPIX Plate 1 Pk Analysis 10-Point
  Standard Curve A dataset containing raw MFI values and metadata from a
  sample plate run (MAGPIX).
- [`example_MAGPIX_pk_10std_plate2_csv`](https://dionnecargy.github.io/SeroTrackR/reference/example_MAGPIX_pk_10std_plate2_csv.md)

  : Example Serological Dataset: MAGPIX Plate 1 Pk Analysis 5-Point
